points.description: Justification: if the lock is available/free, a spinlock acquires it immediately without spinning (spinning only occurs when the lock is held by another thread).
points.partial_credit: Half credit if justification says spinning is only sometimes needed but does not clearly link it to the lock being free/available.

rubric.notes: Full marks need FALSE plus the justification that a spinlock does not spin when the lock is already available. No marks for the justification if the answer says TRUE; the question says no correct justification means no marks, so a bare FALSE with no or wrong justification earns 0. Give part marks only for a vague justification, e.g. spinning is not always needed.
